source: Static, independently triaged Proffera PR #949 evidence at immutable HEAD, 2026-10-31; includes five CodeRabbit test gaps and one ReviewForge functional issue. Offline only; never sent to reviewer.

cases.description: The E2E assertion checks storage only after navigation/cleanup; it cannot detect transient writes of private address/city/postcode before the switch or under a different key.
Calling sessionKey twice on the same sessionStorage only tests cache reuse; it does not establish fresh independent session keys vary with random byte input.
The no-crypto test calls sessionKey alone; it does not prove sendEvent avoids fetch when the generated key is empty.
Mocking sql to return attempts:6 bypasses the ON CONFLICT SQL update and cannot catch a broken counter-reset/preservation path; a DB-backed integration check is required.
Tests call safePhoneHref and safeEmailHref in isolation but do not render the component from stored bookings, so component-level href or conditional rendering regressions are missed.
The new email regular expression rejects RFC-compatible local-part apostrophes, hiding the mailto action for otherwise valid booking email addresses.

unscored.reason: A recommendation for more focused unit tests, but some restore behavior is already covered by E2E. Not a proven broken contract from the inspected code alone.
Plausible RAF/state race, but not reproduced in an isolated browser; defer as candidate runtime defect, not verified ground truth.

observed.note: Historical review executed before the new two-lens prompt was deployed. Do not credit the newer method for this result.

limitations: Test-integrity labels describe concrete blind spots visible from source, not exploited production faults. These references were selected after viewing historical reviews, so cross-PR percentages are descriptive only. Gold data is strictly offline; no model prompt contamination.
